subject: HITNet status: EPE repro green, latency is the open risk
body:
Dmitri, Deshawn,

Status. Eval harness reproduces published-direction numbers on both FlyingThings passes - finalpass EPE within 2% of the reference, cleanpass within 1% - and the three Middlebury half-resolution models (160/288/400 max disparity) all evaluate cleanly. ETH3D done too.

The risk is exactly what Deshawn called out: with default TF ops we're measuring ~92 ms/frame on our target GPU, which is roughly 3x too slow for the real-time story. Farah's custom CUDA op port has the tile-hypothesis propagation kernel working; warp/refinement kernels are in review. Realistic ETA for an end-to-end custom-op model is first week of June, which leaves one week of margin before the LRB slot.

One more trade-off to flag: the released models are fixed disparity range. If LRB asks about arbitrary-range scenes we should say 'later release', not promise it.

Wei
